title: 2023 Score Scorecard #5 NFL Tennessee Titans Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
For avid fans of the National Football League (NFL), this 2023 Score Football card featuring Will Levis of the Tennessee Titans is a must-have addition to your collection. This short print rookie card is a rare find and is sure to elevate your trading card game. 

The card is part of the 2023 Score set, specifically the Scorecard parallel/variety. It boasts the card number #5 and is manufactured by SCORE. As a sports trading card, it is perfect for enthusiasts looking to trade and invest in their favorite NFL players. Get your hands on this highly sought-after card and add it to your collection today!
